<!-- pr-reviewer: 8fd0a47ec3519947a09f3ca78c650b882ff72d05 -->

**Ready to merge after one process fix** (the PR body's closing line: `Refs #3644`, not `Fixes`). The code is solid: the two review findings of `7ce62c040` are closed with a shared `ToolRecords` list and a matching pin on each path, and both the runner quick gate and local clippy are green on the merged tree.

## What looks good

- `crates/app/src/commands/tool_delete.rs`: one shared `ToolRecords` list (record, number, body, cutter, stack) is snapshotted and landed by both delete paths, so a new tool record is added once.
- `crates/app/src/commands/tool_assembly.rs`: `EditDocumentComponent` validates every user tool before the table moves; a refusal names the component id and the tool. The `ChangeTool::assembled` law judges the body that lands in the same step.
- `NewDocument` (`crates/ui/src/state.rs`) now clears the table, as project open does. The `UpsertDocumentComponent` / `EditDocumentComponent` law covers the held-id path.
- The `camcraft_app` re-export of `component`, `component_geometry` and `connection_code` (`crates/app/src/lib.rs`) is documented in `docs/decisions/3644-component-commands.md`.
- Provenance headers on the new modules; `tool.rs` stays under 400 lines (387).

## Results merged with main

- Runner (pr-test.yml, run [45880151793](https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/45880151793), merged with main `763a1dbff523f74975a1df55230066fa9348fdf3`): `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: **304 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled** (26.6 min). Includes `app suites: tool_library_holders` (the 7 pins), `ui suites: machine` (the `new_document_clears_the_component_table` pin) and `app suites: example_catalog`.
- Runner clippy step: failed on the runner's toolchain (`cargo-clippy` is not installed for `stable-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu`), not on code.
- Local (this host, in the merged trial-merge worktree): `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean (exit 0).

## Targeted tests (step 5)

- No post or toolpath change: no example catalog re-run needed (the gate summary includes `example_catalog`: ok, 43 passed, 0 failed).
- Light lane (`cargo xtask gate light`, local, in the merged trial-merge worktree): **6 steps, 0 failed, 0 stalled** (wall 18.2 min): release light build (645 s), `motion light: lib` (7 passed, 321 s), `motion light: adaptive_troch_island` (1 passed), `motion light: adaptive_troch_neck` (1 passed), `motion light: adaptive_troch_parallel` (1 passed), `app light: pocket_pass_start` (1 passed). This is the required light lane run, not the full heavy lanes.
- No `P1` under the safety floor: no targeted heavy step.

## Requested before merge

1. **Process: the PR body ends `Fixes #3644`, which closes the issue on merge.** The work is partial: the file format and user library (#3645), the MCP tools (#3647), the UI (#3648) and the full multi-seat tool record (#3646) all remain open, and the turning insert of the issue's "Done means" is not exercised (#3643 is open for the lathe side). Per AGENTS.md ("The fixing commit ends its body with `Fixes #N` (`Refs #N` for partial work, which does not close)"), the body (and the feat commit's "Fixes #3644" line) must read `Refs #3644`. The commit message cannot be edited without a force-push; please change the body at least, and drop the closing line from the feat commit if you can.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)

- `SetToolAssembly::new` does not refuse a stack equal to the current one, unlike `EditDocumentComponent` ("already so"). An empty undo step is cheap; if you want a law, refuse it by name.
- `SetToolAssembly::new` does not name a test pin for a same-as-current stack; the two review pins cover the rest.
- `camcraft_app` now re-exports `component`/`component_geometry`/`connection_code` of `camcraft_tools` (`crates/app/src/lib.rs`); the decision file covers it, so no new dependency entry is needed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
